    h0 = project_box_sum(parent, grid_size/2)
    best_h = h0.copy()
    best_score = evaluate_score(h0)

            if is_feasible(h_opt):
                h_proj = project_box_sum(h_opt, grid_size/2)
                s = evaluate_score(h_proj)
                if s < best_score:

                    best_h = h_proj.copy()
